description.value: The Vancouver Island Visitor Centre is the regional tourism hub for the Comox Valley, instantly recognizable by the full-scale CT-114 Tutor Jet (formerly Snowbird 5) displayed on its grounds just off the main highway. Inside, it features K'ómoks First Nation art, an exhibition gallery, and a gift shop, with knowledgeable staff ready to help plan local adventures. The outdoor picnic area and playground make it a pleasant rest stop, and it serves as the go-to resource for area maps, route ideas, and local recommendations.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content for experiencecomoxvalley.ca confirms the name, phone (1-250-400-2882), and address (3607 Small Road, Cumberland, BC, V9N 3Z8) from OSM. The site describes the centre as having an outdoor picnic area and playground, a gift shop, and an art/exhibition gallery, but makes no mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or any cyclist-specific amenities, so those fields are null. The centre is actively operating (hours posted, renovation note), and confirmed_open is true.
concerns: OSM address tag is incomplete (missing city, province, and postal code); full address 3607 Small Road, Cumberland, BC, V9N 3Z8 sourced from website.
Website notes ongoing interior renovation work that may affect the visitor experience.
No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water) are confirmed — a direct inquiry to the centre is recommended before listing amenity claims.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A staffed regional visitor centre with outdoor picnic grounds is a genuinely useful stop for touring cyclists seeking local route and area information; the iconic Tutor Jet landmark also makes it easy to locate.
